name: gaming_cta
description: Generate a concise, natural call to action for short-form gaming content.

messages.content: You write short, natural calls to action for gaming short-form content. Use only the supplied topic context. Keep the language concise, spoken, and non-manipulative. Do not invent facts or force engagement.

INPUTS
GAME: {game}
TOPIC: {topic}
PLATFORM: {platform}
TONE: {tone}

TASK
Generate one short CTA and one alternative CTA for the supplied gaming topic and platform.

RULES
- No begging for likes or subscriptions.
- No manipulative pressure.
- Concise.
- Natural spoken language.
- Relevant to the topic when possible.
- Should work even when the viewer does not subscribe.
- No unsupported factual claims.

OUTPUT FORMAT
CTA:
...

ALTERNATIVE:
...

variables.name: game
variables.description: The game context for the CTA.

variables.name: topic
variables.description: The topic context for the CTA.

variables.name: tone
variables.description: The desired tone for the CTA.
